items.problem: The behavior of `end_session` is not set: only `start_session` is said to delete the previous session record, and nothing says that `end_session` deletes the session record of the ctx user. `check_current` (session.md:49) and `verify_signature` (session.md:66-67) return `UNAUTHORIZED` only when there is no record; an implementation that ends the session by overwriting `session_id` instead gives `SESSION_REPLACED`, which the test items at session.md:108 (after `Logout`, after `auth.revoke_login_tokens`) and auth.md:472 rely on being `UNAUTHORIZED`. It also does not set the result of `end_session` for a user with no session record (clone wipe at user-snapshot-clone.md:140 of a user who never logged in after the import)
